children: AirJoule Technologies announced the acquisition of Bitsink, a U.S.-based provider of cooling, power distribution and racking infrastructure for AI and high-density data centers. The deal includes $18 million in cash and 1,859,504 Class A shares at closing, plus up to $40 million in stock earnouts tied to 2027–2029 revenue targets. In a concurrent Subscription Agreement, the seller received the initial stock consideration, with any future earnout also payable in shares under a Section 4(a)(2) exemption. The transaction is intended to strengthen AirJoule Technologies' position in AI and data center infrastructure.
